rationale: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature set—these fields leak information about the target (paid_amount) and are unavailable at claim submission. Feature set now contains only submission-time attributes: claim characteristics (claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status), service details (service_units, length_of_stay), clinical flags (er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag), and diagnosis (primary_icd10_cm). This change will resolve the unrealistic ROC-AUC values (0.9967, 0.9973) to expected range [0.5, 1.0]. Added 'model_limitations' caveat to acknowledge model assumptions and limitations in the report. Logistic regression and random forest models remain for interpretability and non-linear pattern capture.
changes_summary: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set (target leakage correction). Added 'model_limitations' to report caveats. All other components unchanged.
